name: Tolstoy
description: Tel Aviv e-commerce AI platform used by thousands of Shopify brands: AI Studio turns product photos and brand guidelines into on-brand product images and videos, while its AI Player publishes shoppable video/UGC and its AI shopping agents guide buyers.
